name: Matchify
summary: Converts eligible Python if/elif/else chains into match statements.
use_cases: convert if elif else chains to match statements
preview conversions as diffs without writing
features: convert if elif else chains to match
safely transform only when semantics preserved

usage_guide.open_hint: Run `matchify <file> --check` to preview the changes for a Python file as a diff.

features.feature: convert if elif else chains to match
features.title: Convert if/elif/else chains to match statements
steps: Run `matchify <file> --check` to preview the conversion as a diff.
Look for the `+match` lines to see the new match statement.

features.title: Keep comments and formatting when converting
steps: Run `matchify <file> --check` on a file with comments.
Check the diff to see that your comments are kept.

features.feature: safely transform only when semantics preserved
features.title: Convert only when behavior stays the same

check.expected_signal: Convert if/elif/else chains to Python 3.10+ match statements

smoke_tests.expected_signal: Convert if/elif/else chains to Python 3.10+ match statements
smoke_tests.observed_excerpt: Convert if/elif/else chains to Python 3.10+ match statements

setup.command:
mkdir -p proj && cat > example_simple.py <<'PY'
x = 2
if x == 1:
    print("one")
elif x == 2:
    print("two")
else:
    print("other")
PY
cat > example_format.py <<'PY'
# leading comment preserved?
x = 1  # inline comment
if x == 1:  # branch comment
    print("one")  # action comment
elif x == 2:
    print("two")
else:
    print("other")  # else comment
PY
cat > example_safe.py <<'PY'
x = 1
y = 2
if x == 1:
    print("x is one")
elif y == 2:
    print("y is two")
else:
    print("other")
PY
cat proj/a.py <<'PY'
x = 1
if x == 1:
    print("one")
elif x == 2:
    print("two")
else:
    print("other")
PY
cat proj/b.py <<'PY'
y = "a"
if y == "a":
    print("a")
elif y == "b":
    print("b")
else:
    print("other")
PY
ls -R
